Covers: greening of roofs, façades and courtyards ('Bauwerks- und Hofbegrünung') -- construction/installation of the greening measure itself, funded up to €4,000 per project generally, or up to €8,000 for intensive green roofs; green roofs additionally yield a separate, indirect benefit of reduced stormwater (Regenwasserentgelt) fees. Excluded/not stated: no mention of coverage for trees alone, rain gardens, permeable paving, rainwater barrels/cisterns, or of planning/design, permitting, or maintenance costs.

Covers: production/installation costs for green roofs and facades (substrate, vegetation, planting, irrigation, climbing aids, soil prep/replacement, wall-bound systems ≥10m², solar substructure add-on, structural reinforcement for solar-green roofs, ancillary planning/supervision costs up to 15% of eligible costs, 2-year completion-care/maintenance, qualified own-labour up to 60% of material costs). Excludes: measures legally mandated/required by regulation (not voluntary), roofs with slope >30°, projects below minimum size (20m² net vegetation for roofs, €1,000 min. cost / 10m² min. for wall-bound facade systems), ongoing long-term maintenance beyond the 2-year completion-care period

Covers: production/construction costs of green roofs (substrate, planting per required min. thickness), facade greening preparatory works, soil preparation, climbing aids/pergolas, planting, irrigation/rainwater storage systems, 2-year establishment maintenance, planning/site-supervision/inspection/advisory ancillary costs (capped 15%), solar-green-roof substructure (€50/m²), load-bearing capacity upgrades for solar-green roofs, qualified own-labour material costs (up to 60%). Excludes: greening required by legal/planning obligation (not voluntary), long-term/annual maintenance beyond 2 years, costs above 100,000€ per building/structure

Covers 75% of eligible expenditure (installation/materials costs) for: any type of green-roof and green-façade greening (wall- or ground-bound, incl. wall, bin-enclosure and carport greening), depaving/desealing and naturalistic greening of plot surfaces (incl. gravel-garden conversion), and installation of cisterns for rainwater use -- up to a maximum grant of €20,000 per project. Free on-site landscape-planning consultation is included as an in-kind component for applicants within the funding area (currently paused). Restricted to properties within the designated Fördergebiet (Hanau-Lamboy and the eastern part of Hanau-Nordwest); excluded/not covered: cash grants for properties outside this Fördergebiet, which instead only qualify for free advisory site visits (also currently paused) with no cash-grant coverage; routine/ongoing maintenance costs are not mentioned as covered.

Covers: professionally installed roof and façade greening costs (1/3 of eligible costs for roof greening, 50% if combined with PV; 50% for DIY simple façade greening), plus structural check/calculation (up to €450) and prior professional consultation (up to €200, or €400 with PV). Also covers new-build and retrofit greening on any plot in the Region Hannover area. Excludes: non-voluntary/mandated measures; roofs under 25 m²; ongoing maintenance costs not stated as covered .

Covers: material/substrate and planting costs for green-roof installation on individual garages/carports up to 20m², evidenced by invoices (with substrate-thickness line item) and a species/planting list. Excludes: costs beyond installation (no design/planning, permitting, maintenance, or monitoring costs are reimbursed); excludes greening measures already mandated by binding land-use plans/statutes (Bebauungspläne) or required as legal nature-conservation compensation (Ausgleichs-/Ersatzmaßnahmen)

Covers eligible planning, materials, construction, preparatory works and establishment maintenance; courtyard works may include removal and disposal. Self-delivery covers only materials and, for courtyards, disposal. Excludes compulsory measures, measures begun before approval, unauthorised works, combination with other funding, existing green-roof/façade rehabilitation and specified ineligible materials/features.

Covers: material and installation costs for the vegetation build-up layer (protective layer, filter fleece, drainage, substrate, plants) on roofs and for façade greening systems (climbing aids, ground preparation, plants), plus planning/installation fees by qualified external professionals, at 50% up to €50/m² and €3,000 total per applicant. Excludes: roof waterproofing/sealing (assumed as prerequisite, not funded), works on new buildings (<5 years since completion), measures already required by building permit/zoning plan (Bebauungsplan) conditions, double-funded measures, planter/pot-only installations, own/DIY or friends'/family labour (only 50% of material cost eligible if self-installed), and any costs already covered by other funding sources.

Covered: Begrünung von Fassaden, Wänden und Dächern an Bestandsgebäuden; Entsiegelung und Begrünung (inkl. Baumpflanzungen) von Vorgärten, Hof- und Freiflächen; Anlegen von insektenfreundlichen Grünflächen. Exclusions not stated.

Covers: installation ("Anlage") of green roof systems on house and garage roofs of existing buildings (Bestandsgebäude), funded up to €5,000 per project, within the programme's overall budget cap (€168,000, potentially +€80,000 more). Excludes: new-build roofs (non-Bestandsgebäude construction) ; no mention of coverage for planning/design, permitting, maintenance or monitoring costs -- Not stated.

Covers: desealing (Entsiegelung) of paved/sealed surfaces, subsequent greening (perennial beds, lawns/meadows, tree/shrub planting), removal and greening of gravel gardens (Schottergärten), roof greening, façade greening; excludes: any resurfacing/paving even with permeable materials (since June 2022), general path/surface hardening of any kind

Covers: construction/material costs for green roof, façade greening and courtyard depaving works (from top of roof waterproofing upward; ground preparation/soil replacement; climbing aids/façade systems incl. automatic irrigation; permeable surfacing; raised beds/planters; pergolas; design/architect & engineering planning; completion-phase maintenance per DIN 18320 for 12 months). Excludes: large sealed roof-terrace/path surfaces, façade renovation/repair costs, structural/static reinforcement costs, green roofs on asbestos/PVC roofing, structures other than pergolas, shelters, elaborate garden features (sculptures, fountains), unrelated technical installations, movable furniture (except permanent planters), lighting, in-kind/self-performed labour hours, and post-completion (ongoing) maintenance measures.

Covers: all planning, material and construction/installation costs from top of roof waterproofing (for roofs) or all planning/material/installation costs directly related to façade greening incl. climbing aids, planters, plants, irrigation systems, and de-sealing for ground-bound systems; structural reinforcement surcharge and root-protection film surcharge for roofs; PV-combination surcharge for solar green roofs; establishment-phase maintenance (1yr roof / 2yr façade). Excludes: measures required by legal/public-law obligation (e.g. building permit conditions or B-Plan requirements), green roofs on asbestos/PVC/herbicide-containing roof coverings, ongoing maintenance beyond the establishment period, façade greening in public space that would reduce residual footpath width below 2.5m, and measures on land classified as 'Außenbereich' (undeveloped/outlying area) under building law

Covers: all construction costs from top of roof waterproofing upward related to the greening measure (substrate, drainage, plants, root barrier retrofit, structural/statics reinforcement for load-bearing), plus completion/establishment maintenance (Fertigstellungspflege) if part of contracted works. Excludes: roof waterproofing/sealing itself (Dachabdichtungen), though extra cost of waterproofing with integrated root barrier is partially recognized; greening of asbestos- or PVC-containing roof coverings not funded; single plant containers/pots not eligible (must be contiguous area ≥4m²)

Cannot fully restore automatically; at minimum include green-roof waterproofing/insulation layers, drainage layers, substrate, plants and associated construction costs; human to restore complete 2025-guideline scope

Roof/facade: covers eligible vegetation-layer materials and installation, planting/seeding, climbing aids, facade systems and planted pergolas; own labour only through documented material costs. Garden: covers 50% of ecologically valuable native planting; detailed absolute garden caps are not stated on the current page

Covers: construction/installation costs of professional new-build and retrofit roof greening (extensive or intensive, min. 25 m² roof area) and façade greening on any plot in Region Hannover, funded at 1/3 of eligible costs (roof) or 50% (façade, DIY simple installations); combined PV+green-roof installations funded at up to 50% of eligible roof-greening costs; ancillary structural assessment (up to €450) and prior professional advisory consultation (up to €200, or €400 with PV) costs. Excludes: legally/mandatorily required (non-voluntary) measures; ongoing maintenance costs (10-year plant maintenance/permanence is a funding condition, not itself funded).

Covers: material and ancillary costs directly linked to installation of roof greening from top of roof sealing upward (protective fleece, filter mat, drainage layer, substrate, seeding/planting), for extensive green roofs fully and for intensive green roofs only the extensively-managed portion. Excludes: own labour (Eigenleistung), costs for asbestos-containing roof sealing, renovation of existing green roofs, mere placement of planters, projects already funded elsewhere, projects in outdoor/undeveloped area (§35 BauGB), and works already begun before application (with limited 2021 transition exception)

Covers a one-off grant of 50% of eligible/documented costs (per quote/price comparison or contractor offer) for installation (materials and construction) of green roof or green façade measures on a building in Lippstadt. Excluded: measures already commissioned/started before grant approval; measures financed with other public funds (no double funding); and technical/structural feasibility or static load-bearing assessment, which is explicitly not checked by the approving authority and remains the responsibility of the applicant or their contractor.

Covers material/installation costs per measure, generally at a defined co-funding share/rate, not full reimbursement: (1) green roofs -- substrate-bound vegetation only, up to 50% of actual costs, max €18/m², cap €1,500/project (excl. legally-mandated roofs, individual planters, gravel/paving/deck coverings); (2) façade greening with ground contact (no pot/container plantings), up to 50% of costs, cap €1,000/project; (3) dry-stone wall/terrace restoration in vineyards, flat €100/m² or per running metre, cap €10,000/applicant/year (excl. minor damage, mortared joints, concrete parts, except exceptional back-concreting); (4) desealing/greening of ≥10m² sealed plots in built-up areas, 50% of costs, max €18/m², cap €1,500/project (excl. permeable 'eco-stone' pavement, and desealing linked to new-build sealing or demolition-rebuild); (5) nature conservation/species projects: 100% of agreed plant material cost plus 50% of other necessary material/installation costs, max €500/measure/year (excl. labour time, postage, fax, phone costs); (6) cisterns for new or existing buildings: €50/m³ capacity, cap €1,000/object, min. grant €100; (7) geothermal probe drilling only: €6/drilled metre, cap €1,000/project. Programme-wide exclusions: legally-mandated measures (Sec. 7.2) and, for measures under 2.1-2.3, 2.6, 2.8, 2.9, works begun before application approval unless an exception is granted (Sec. 6.1).
Covers material, labour and incidental costs including VAT, up to 50% and subject to measure-specific per-m² and per-measure caps
Planning, materials and construction from roof waterproofing upward, including plants; eligible structural-capacity preparation, root protection and first-year finishing maintenance

Covers roof structural/planning/site-supervision and vegetation-layer construction costs; facade climbing aids, plants, planting and necessary ground-surface removal/replacement; DIY roof work is limited to 50% of material costs, with tools/hours excluded and special-equipment rental eligible. Excludes measures already begun, publicly mandated measures, insufficient-quality works and non-eligible administrative/financing costs stated in the guideline
Green-roof installation; contractor or self-build eligible; €50/m²; detailed cost-category list not stated on operator page

Covers publicly-funded execution costs of green infrastructure on public/municipal, school, and Wohnbau Mainz (housing-company) land -- depaving/permeable resurfacing, tree planting incl. engineered tree pits with irrigation/aeration/root-protection systems, perennial and native meadow/wildflower planting, habitat structures (dry-stone walls, insect hotels, nest boxes), urban-gardening infrastructure (raised beds, fencing/enclosures), and external landscape-architect design fees; excludes private homeowner installation/permitting costs and long-term maintenance, which falls to tenant volunteers ("Beetpaten") -- no cash subsidy scheme for private green roofs/façades/rain gardens is documented in the source.

Covered: costs/materials additionally required for the greening measure itself, itemised per measure type -- (1) Green roofs: root protection membranes, drainage layers, greening substrates and plants, additional to the roof waterproofing itself (which is not covered); (2) Facade greening: climbing aids, planters, creation of planting areas, and climbing plants, for permanent area-wide facade greening; (3) Desealing & greening: removal of unvegetated sealed surfaces (paving, concrete, asphalt) and permanent greening with connection to natural soil. Funding amount is calculated based on verified/proven costs ("Die Förderhöhe errechnet sich anhand der nachgewiesenen Kosten"). Excluded: cases where greening is already legally mandated under the city's Begrünungsordnung (no funding given in that case); the roof waterproofing itself is not funded, only additional green-roof-specific components; planning/design, permitting, ongoing maintenance and monitoring costs are not mentioned as covered .
Covers 50% of eligible green-roof costs arising above the roof waterproofing layer, up to €5,000 per applicant and property; maintenance apparently excluded

Covers zuwendungsfähige Ausgaben (eligible expenditures) for the physical greening measure itself -- investments and multi-year, primarily native plantings for green roof (intensive/extensive) and green façade installations on existing private/commercial buildings; excludes projects mandatory under other contractual/legal obligations (e.g. B-Plan requirements or the city's own Gründachsatzung for new builds), which are excluded from funding.
Eligible Hof-/Dachbegrünung measure costs plus planning costs up to the guideline limit; exclusions include utilities, movable furnishings/plants, administration and financing costs

Covers: material and installation costs for façade renovation/cleaning/painting, historic window/door restoration, façade greening, depaving/greening of courtyards and gardens, green roofs, plus up to 10% of costs for required planning/site-supervision advice by a recognised professional. Excludes: self-performed labour, work not done by approved specialist firms, thermal insulation (except final render/paint coat), measures fundable under other programmes (noise protection, KfW/NRW-Bank, monument conservation), new car parking spaces, utility line changes, administrative/legal/financing costs, and any measure costing under the €1,000 de minimis threshold (except removal of signage).

Covers: greening of courtyards, front gardens, roofs, and facades; nature-near greening of company premises; desealing of paved/asphalted private surfaces (replacement with permeable paving or planting). Eligibility requires the measure be voluntary, and either the property has ≥4 residential units or is a commercial property (roof greening exempt from the unit-count rule). Excludes/Not stated: design/permitting fees, monitoring costs, and ongoing maintenance costs are not stated as covered.

Covers: 50% of costs for green roof installation components (vegetation layer, root-proof sealing, protective fleece, drainage elements, filter fleece, substrate), up to €40/m² and €10,000 per property, subject to overall programme caps (€20,000/€40,000 per building type, €250,000/applicant/year, min. €500 grant threshold). Excludes: measures started before application confirmation, measures required by planning/building law, heritage/preservation-area measures without prior permit, predominantly commercial buildings, DIY/self-performed work, and (implicitly) ongoing maintenance, design/planning, permitting and monitoring costs which are not listed as eligible items. Separately, a non-grant benefit is the stormwater utility fee reduction (80-90%) for green roofs, unrelated to the capital grant.

Covers two categories: (1) Façade renovation (Fassadensanierung) -- renewal of plaster, façade paint, roof re-covering, replacement/refurbishment of windows, balcony renovation, gutters/downpipes, front door replacement, and renovation of doorbell/intercom/mailbox systems; and (2) Courtyard design (Hofgestaltung) -- demolition of derelict structures in inner courtyards, desealing of courtyard surfaces, creation of green areas/paths/plazas, planting measures, and greening of walls/roof surfaces. Excluded: technical installations such as AC units, satellite dishes, and roller shutter boxes are not fundable and must be removed from the front façade as part of the renovation. Scope is limited to the defined Neu-Ulm inner-city area (Innenstadtbereich).

Covers 'entstandene Kosten laut Beleg' -- Sach- und Materialkosten (including equipment hire), plus Planungs- und Baukosten and comparable service-provider costs -- at the per-measure rate and cap (e.g. Fenster €150/window, Türen €300/door, max €1,200; Dämmung 20% max €1,800; Zukunftshaus €3,000 flat; Lastenrad 20% max €500; Flächenentsiegelung 50% max €2,000; Zisterne 50% max €1,500; Gründach/Fassadenbegrünung 50% max €2,000; Gartenumgestaltung 30% max €800; Bonus Bauherrengemeinschaft 10% max €300, Zisternenanschluss €300). Excludes: Eigenleistungen in the form of own labour (materials only); measures required by law or by a Bebauungsplan; measures conflicting with building law or Denkmalschutz; costs whose Angemessenheit cannot be established beyond doubt; second-hand bicycles; and double funding/cumulation for Flächenentsiegelung and Gartenumgestaltung.

Covers greening measures citywide for owners, tenants, associations/initiatives, and SME commercial buildings: green roofs, green façades, depaving/removal of gravel gardens with re-greening, and rainwater retention/cisterns (including planning/design and contractor works, plus completion-phase aftercare if part of the works contract). Excludes: roof waterproofing/sealing; areas already subject to building/zoning-plan obligations; elaborate garden features (sculptures, fountains, etc.); planters/balcony planting; general garden renovation; ongoing care/maintenance beyond completion-phase aftercare; combination with other funding programmes where total funding would exceed 100%; and projects with total gross costs below €300.

Covers: professional planning/design costs; new tree-planting sites; roof and facade greening (incl. necessary ancillary costs); desealing of paved surfaces and qualified greening of resulting open space with native/site-appropriate woody plants and perennials (incl. fruit trees); rainwater use/infiltration measures (barrels, soakaway pits, cisterns, ponds) only combined with other greening; greening of new garages/carports and subordinate extensions; biodiversity/nesting habitat measures; greened pergolas/trellises; natural play corners as part of desealing. Excludes: temporary measures (planters, raised beds), replacement plantings, pure redesign without desealing, turf-laying (Rollrasen), irrigation systems, works begun before approval notice, greening of new main buildings, and pure paving even if permeability is increased.

Covers: installation of green roofs (materials/construction, whether self-installed or via contractor) on garages, extensions, carports and similar structures, up to 60 m² of roof area per property, for roofs connected to the combined or separate sewer system within the Emschergenossenschaft catchment. Excludes: measures already mandated by a development plan/statute (Bebauungsplan/Satzung) as an obligation, measures already started before application, measures already funded via another funding programme, and roof areas beyond the 60 m² cap.

Covers: 50% of eligible/documented implementation costs (materials + execution, per submitted cost estimate/quote/invoice) for the four measure categories (green roofs, façade greening, de-sealing with greening, cisterns), up to measure-specific per-m²/per-litre-tier caps and an overall €10,000/property cap. Excludes: VAT for input-tax-deductible businesses (VAT not an eligible cost); measures that are legally mandated (e.g. via a Bebauungsplan) -- only voluntary measures qualify; and, where de-sealing or cisterns are self-performed (Eigenleistung), the execution/installation cost component cannot be claimed (only material costs, materials cost eligibility inferred). Ongoing maintenance, planning/permitting fees, and monitoring costs are not mentioned as eligible .

Covers roof/façade installation materials and works; façade planning/supervision and preparatory works; static assessment; and establishment/completion maintenance. Exclusions and technical conditions remain as stated in the guidelines.

Covers: planning/design, material and construction costs for roof greening, façade greening (incl. climbing aids, plants, planters, and de-sealing for ground-based systems), depaving/greening of sealed surfaces (incl. disposal of old surface, partial permeable paving up to 50%), first-year establishment maintenance ('Fertigstellungspflege'), and structural reinforcement of roofs for green roof installation. Excludes: measures legally mandated (e.g. via Bebauungsplan or building permit conditions), renovation of existing green roofs or façades being greened, individual planters/gravel/paved decorative surfaces, decoration/furniture, works after the approval period ends, ancillary installations like bike racks/drainage/fencing, and any work begun before formal approval.

Covers eligible costs for roof greening, façade greening and de-sealing of courtyards/parking areas; 30-50% depending on applicant, max €5,000. Excludes non-greening measures such as balcony solar devices

Covered: planning, materials, construction/installation from roof membrane level, root barrier (retrofit), first-year maintenance, PV-compatible roof greening (greening only, not PV). Excluded: measures started before approval, legally mandated greening, asbestos/PVC/herbicide roofs, maintenance beyond year one, roof/facade repairs, planter boxes

Covers physical construction and substrate/planting materials (substrate ≥10 cm) for green roof installations on qualifying buildings; excludes work started prior to funding approval, maintenance, and monitoring

Covers direct capital/installation costs of the four eligible measures at fixed per-measure rates: extensive green roof (€25/m², max €2,500, min. 15 m² contiguous), intensive green roof (€40/m², max €4,000, min. 15 m² contiguous), façade greening (50% of recognized eligible costs, min. €200 eligible costs, max €1,500), and desealing (€25/m², max €2,500, min. 15 m² contiguous). Excludes: measures already started or completed before the written funding approval (Bewilligungsbescheid) -- for roof greening/desealing "start" means actual physical execution (obtaining quotes/planning services does not count as start; awarding a contract is not detrimental), while for façade greening the purchase/delivery date is decisive; planning/quote-gathering costs themselves are not listed as eligible costs; and maintenance/monitoring costs are not covered (no line item provided) .

Covers: installation ("Anlegen"/"Installation") of green roofs and green façades on residential buildings (new and existing) within Remscheid city area; grant scaled by m² up to €5,000 for green roofs, and based on total costs up to €500 for green façades. Excludes/does not separately fund: combination with photovoltaic or retention roofs (welcomed but not explicitly funded); maintenance costs; other measures (rainwater storage, rain gardens, permeable paving, trees) are not mentioned as covered. Note: a separate 50% stormwater fee reduction exists for adequately-built-up green roofs, but this is a distinct ongoing fiscal benefit, not part of the capital cost-coverage grant.

Covers: conversion/desealing of sealed surfaces into infiltration-capable surfaces (removal of old pavement, installation of new pavement raising infiltration ≥50%); on-site infiltration measures (surface, swale, pond infiltration); rainwater retention systems (cisterns, soakaways) meeting min. 3m³/100m² volume with throttled discharge; green roofs (as retention or as decoupling measure); separated discharge to surface water; own labour at €15/hour. Excludes: stone/gravel garden conversions (excluded for biodiversity reasons); costs exceeding actual incurred expenses; measures already required by other legal/statutory obligations (e.g., building-code mandated infiltration, Bauleitplanung requirements); combinable/simultaneous funding from other public programmes (double funding excluded); projects already begun before approval; measures where required permits/approvals are not obtained.

Covers: (1) capital/grant funding for green roof and green façade installation ("Dach- und Fassadenbegrünung"), applied for via the city's Klimaschutz- und -anpassungsförderprogramm (climate protection and adaptation funding programme) -- eligible cost categories and amounts not specified on this page; (2) a recurring 50% reduction of the stormwater fee (Niederschlagsgebühr) for fully/gapless vegetated ("lückenlos bepflanzte") green roofs, achieved by counting the green roof area at only half its built-up/sealed area in the fee assessment. Excluded/Not stated: design, planning, permitting, monitoring, or maintenance costs are not mentioned; other NbS measure types (rain gardens, permeable paving, trees, rain barrels) are not addressed on this page.

Covers contractor installation, materials, planting, advisory and planning services; up to 50%, capped by roof type and generally €5,000/property. Excludes own labour, mandatory greening, unrelated technical systems and specified unsuitable works. Maintenance costs not stated.

Covers eligible design/ancillary, construction, installation and planting costs for depaving, courtyard/entrance greening, façades, roofs and flowering areas; excludes compulsory measures and work begun before agreement

Covers: materials (seeds, plants, soil, pots, climbing aids, trees, tree protection, nesting boxes, sealing-removal disposal, vegetation surface creation), delivery by contracted firms, and craftsman/installation labour for proper execution; lift/hoist rental for high-altitude nest box installation. Excludes: green roofs, own/DIY labour (implied, since only third-party contracted costs are named), measures legally/publicly mandated anyway (e.g. compensation/offset planting obligations), measures outside Tübingen municipal area, measures already credited under Ökokonto/compensation points, and any design/planning, permitting, maintenance or monitoring costs (not listed as eligible)

Covers: (1) bodengebundene (ground-based) façade greening on privately owned buildings within a defined inner-city funding area (bounded by Jägerstraße/Clarissenstraße/Königsstraße, the railway tracks, Zollernring/Staufenring, and the Danube/Sedanstraße), and (2) installation of artificial nesting aids/cavities for building-dwelling species (house martins, swifts, bats, half-cavity nesters) on the applicant's own building . Excludes: measures that are legally mandated by law, ordinance, statute, development plan (Bebauungsplan), building code (Bauordnung) or building permit (Baugenehmigung) conditions.

Covers: (1) municipal funding ("Förderangebote") for private-property de-sealing (Grundstücksentsiegelung) and roof/façade greening under the "Fassaden- und Wohnumfeldprogramm"; (2) free general information/advice via the municipal climate-adaptation manager, flyers, information events, heavy-rain hazard maps, and free consultation from Verbraucherzentrale NRW on backflow protection/wastewater/heavy-rain protection. Excludes: individual case-by-case technical consultation (explicitly not provided by TBV/City of Velbert); insurance advice on Elementarschadenversicherung is available but at cost to the citizen (not free/covered). No mention of coverage for planning, permitting, monitoring, or maintenance costs.

Covers: installation/construction costs for permanent extensive or intensive green roofs (from top of roof waterproofing) and ground-bound green façades on existing or already-approved new buildings; and, under the separate scheme, tree-care measures and professional tree assessments for qualifying old native deciduous trees (crown care, stabilisation systems, soil improvement). Excludes: nurseries/orchards/tree-nursery stock, trees already funded by other programmes, and (for roofs/façades) any costs below the minimum grant threshold of €500; no mention of covering design/planning, permitting, or monitoring costs.

Covers: green roof (only if combined with PV) installation costs, gravel-garden (Schottergarten) removal/conversion to ≥70% planted, rainwater cistern install, greywater reuse system install, infiltration trench/desealing works -- up to 50% of eligible/attributable costs or flat €500 cap per measure, whichever lower, min. €300 grant threshold. Excludes: own labour (Eigenleistung) and work done by firms owned by the applicant; excludes measures already legally required (mandatory obligations excluded per declaration); excludes standalone green roofs without PV, façade greening, and street trees (not listed as eligible measures).

Covers (up to 85% of eligible costs, max €20,000/project): green roof/façade greening, desealing of surfaces for rainwater infiltration, rainwater harvesting via cisterns, greening/design of courtyards and shared open spaces (incl. play areas and gardens), and preparatory/accompanying measures (analyses, desealing works, demolition). Eligible applicants: private property owners, associations, leaseholders (Erbbauberechtigte), cooperatives and owner communities, on owner-occupied or rented buildings. Geographically limited to the designated Kostheim-Mitte funding area (per Gebietsabgrenzung/Abgrenzung Fördergebiet map); applications accepted through 31 Dec 2027. Excludes: projects/costs incurred before formal approval of the funding application (work must not start before Bewilligung, otherwise funding is excluded entirely); projects outside the designated funding area. Not stated/not addressed as eligible cost types: ongoing maintenance, monitoring, or permitting fees.

Covers planning and construction of eligible systems; 12-month establishment care for roofs/façades; excludes later operation, ordinary applicant labour, legally required measures, renovations and double funding

Covers: depaving works (materials, incorporation of topsoil, removal of removed material, native/climate-adapted planting -- each partially at 20% of invoice), infiltration systems (swales, trenches/rigoles, shafts), downspout disconnection, cisterns, green roofs (extensive/intensive by substrate depth), green façade systems (planting/soil work, climbing aids, irrigation, planters, installation labour). Excludes: measures required by public-law obligations (e.g. Bebauungsplan, Begrünungssatzung/greening statutes), commercial-use buildings, sites with building-law or heritage-protection conflicts, sites outside Worms city area, measures implemented before 01.01.2025, new-build depaving/infiltration (only green roofs allowed on new builds), and use of the depaved area as a parking space

Materials and contractor installation services; self-installation limited to materials; routine maintenance excluded except completion maintenance; financing, permit-requiring construction, existing required greening and specified decorative works excluded

Covers: material costs (plants, climbing aids, substrates, irrigation systems, root barriers), installation/implementation labor by specialist firms, planning/inspection fees (max 10% of total costs), soil preparation, surface removal, wall/fence removal linked to greening. Excludes: measures required by legal obligation (replacement plantings, building permit conditions, redevelopment area requirements), self-performed labor (except up to 25% for non-profits on urban greening projects), ongoing maintenance/upkeep after completion (except contractually-agreed completion care), pure infrastructure (e.g. lighting) or luxury features (e.g. sculptures, fountains)

Covers: purchase and planting of plants, topsoil/humus procurement and application, earthworks, breaking up existing paving, creating green cassettes, green wall/green roof installation (minimum 60% of grant must go to these plant-related items). Excludes/uncovered: remaining up to 40% of grant may cover other project costs (unspecified), but applicant must supply minimum 10% own contribution of total project cost; grant is reimbursement-based so upfront costs are borne by applicant first.

Covers 70% of the purchase price of a programme rainwater collector, compost bin or leaf-composting rack; participant pays 30%, receives an invoice and collects the item at the organised handover; no current-round labour, delivery, maintenance or replacement coverage is stated

Covered: The programme provides eligible applicants (registered residents/inhabitants of District XVI, plus institutions and public-benefit/non-profit organisations operating in the district) with municipal support for a rainwater (csapadékvíz) collection/storage vessel, to enable storage and reuse ('tárolás és hasznosítás') of stormwater generated on the applicant's property; the application procedure itself is fee-free (illetékmentes). Excluded/Not stated: The accessible sources (the online procedure page and the blank application-form PDF) do not specify the covered cost items (e.g., purchase price, installation, delivery, or long-term maintenance of the vessel) or any monetary cap -- these details are said to sit in the underlying decree 27/2015. (XI. 2.) on residential rainwater-utilisation support, which was not supplied in full, so scope of covered costs beyond the fee-free procedure is Not stated.
Covers one free plastic household rainwater tank; participant must collect, protect and use it properly; municipal delivery and storage are not provided

Covers: the physical 300-litre rainwater harvesting kit only (plastic tank, lid, height-extension collar, tap, connector kit for standard gutter downpipes, and assembly instructions), provided free of charge. Excludes: transport, assembly/installation, and commissioning of the tank (all borne by the recipient at own cost); and excludes any repair or replacement after handover (explicitly not provided by the municipality).

Bill rebate: 10% of total bill for functional RWH; 15% if both RWH and wastewater recycling are functional. Capital assistance: 50% of RWH construction cost with plot-size-dependent caps (exact tier ladder requires PDF verification). Penalty: 1.5× enhanced tariff for applicable ≥500 m² non-compliant properties.

Covers: capital financial assistance for RWH installation (50% of system cost, capped at ₹25,000 for plots 100-499.99 m² and ₹50,000 for plots ≥500 m²), plus 10% monthly bill rebate for functional RWH (additional 5% where effluent-treatment plants are installed and functional); penalty 1.5× the monthly bill for DJB consumers on plots ≥500 m² without adequate functional RWH.

Covers up to 100% of eligible/vouched capital expenditure (goods, services, works) for approved community climate/NbS projects across the five funding themes (Energy, Travel, Food and Waste, Shopping and Recycling, Local Climate and Environmental Action), procured per stated quote/tender thresholds, with only vouched expenditure reimbursed (applicants pay first, then claim); excludes non-capital/operational costs (a specific ineligible cost list is referenced in the source but was truncated in the excerpt) ; private individuals, commercial undertakings, and national community/environmental organisations are excluded from funding entirely as they are ineligible applicants.

Covers up to 100% funding of not-for-profit community group projects across five themes (Community Energy; Travel, Food & Waste; Shopping & Recycling; Local Climate & Environmental Action), including capital/installation costs such as solar panels, rainwater harvesting, biodiversity/mini-forest and wetland creation, and food waste biodigesters; excludes for-profit/private entities and individual household works (only registered not-for-profit community groups/PPN/Tidy Towns collectives eligible), with reimbursement tied to milestone achievement over an 18-month project period; ongoing operational/maintenance costs after project completion are not stated as covered

Covers cost of purchasing or self-building a rainwater storage tank (≥150L capacity) including DIY construction/modification costs, capped per unit; excludes tanks installed for resale by real-estate/commercial operators, and excludes additional tanks at a site that already received this subsidy.

Covered: 1/2 of the combined purchase price + installation cost of an eligible rainwater storage tank (tax included), with the subsidy amount rounded down to the nearest ¥1,000, capped at ¥30,000 per tank; limited to 2 tanks per household per fiscal year. Eligible tanks must be pre-made/commercial products (既製品) with a usable water-outlet fitting (e.g. tap), with storage capacity ≥100L (multiple connected tanks may be combined to reach 100L, counted as one unit). Excluded: maintenance/upkeep costs after installation; tanks used for non-household purposes (e.g. factories, farmland) -- use is limited to the applicant's own household; re-installation at the same site is restricted unless 5+ years have passed since the previous subsidy use at that location. No permitting cost is mentioned/required in the source.

Covers a portion (1/2 or 2/3 of construction cost, subject to per-item caps and an overall ¥150,000 cap) of installation costs for rainwater storage/infiltration facilities: commercial rain tanks (市販雨水貯留槽), infiltration catch basins/pipes/side-ditches (浸透ます・浸透管・浸透側溝), permeable paving (透水性舗装), and septic-tank-to-cistern conversion work (既存浄化槽転用雨水貯留槽: sludge removal, partition drilling, drain-pipe fitting, pump installation). Excludes: replacement of existing facilities, items/work done before approval, amounts exceeding the caps, facilities also receiving other subsidies, applicants with unpaid municipal taxes, facilities whose installation is legally mandated under land development regulations, and other cases deemed inappropriate for the subsidy; ongoing maintenance costs are not covered under this scheme.

Covers: in-kind supply of annual/perennial flower plants (begonia, salvia, marigold, petunia, lavender, shibazakura), marigold/cosmos seeds, and leaf-mold soil improver for community-built flower beds on public roadside planting strips/public facility beds. Excludes: private residential gardens and company-owned land (explicitly excluded); no cash grants, no maintenance funding, no coverage for green roofs/walls/rain gardens/permeable paving/rainwater harvesting.

Covers: partial subsidy of installation/設置費 for rainwater storage tanks (雨水貯留槽/雨水タンク) alongside five energy-related equipment types (solar PV, home battery storage ≥2kWh, home fuel cell/Enefarm, HEMS, V2H). Excludes: no coverage stated for green roofs, green façades, rain gardens, permeable paving, or tree planting; no explicit mention of design/permitting/monitoring/maintenance cost coverage for the rain tank component.

Covers: 1/2 of the total purchase cost (購入費) and installation/construction cost (工事費) of a qualifying rainwater storage tank system (tank ≥100L effective capacity, market-sold, for garden-watering use, meeting the city's technical standards) and its ancillary fittings (gutter/collection connection, inflow filter, overflow-prevention fitting), rounded down to the nearest ¥1,000, capped at ¥30,000 per unit, limited to one unit per application/building (multiple simultaneous tanks on one building only count as one unit unless connected as a single system). Excludes: design, permitting, and maintenance/monitoring costs (not listed as covered items); tanks under 100L or non-commercial/custom tanks (unless city-approved exception); national/local government or equivalent bodies as applicants; buildings for which the subsidy was already granted; buildings intended for sale; and any additional units beyond the one per application/building.

Covers eligible rooftop/wall planting, soil, base and irrigation works in the central commercial area and eligible rainwater tank, septic-conversion and infiltration-pit equipment/material/installation costs in the rainwater service area; component-specific rates and caps apply

Covers 1/2 of the rainwater tank body and accessory purchase price including consumption tax, capped at ¥30,000 and rounded down below ¥1,000, once per dwelling; installation and delivery costs are excluded

Covers a share of installation/construction costs for five structural facility types on private residential land (宅地等) built to specified construction standards: (1) rainwater storage tanks ≥100L (¥15,000/unit if 100-200L, ¥25,000/unit if ≥200L, or 2/3 of eligible cost, whichever is lower), (2) infiltration catch basins/masu (¥5,000/unit or 2/3, lower), (3) infiltration pipes (¥3,000/m or 2/3, lower), (4) infiltration U-type side ditches (¥3,500/m or 2/3, lower), and (5) permeable paving (¥1,000/m² or 2/3, lower); total grant capped at ¥100,000 per land parcel, with sub-¥1,000 fractions rounded down. Excludes facilities requiring the Aichi Prefectural Governor's permit under Article 9 of the Act on Special Measures for Flood Damage Countermeasures in Specified Urban Rivers (rainwater storage tanks remain eligible despite this). Design/planning fees, permitting fees, ongoing maintenance, and monitoring costs are not mentioned as covered.

Two-scheme cost coverage: (1) Rainwater tank subsidy -- covers 1/2 of the purchase and installation cost of the tank (excluding consumption tax), capped at ¥35,000, one tank per household with no capacity limit; excludes corporations/public bodies (state, local government, public corporations, etc.), installations in temporary structures, and installations for resale purposes. (2) Infiltration trench (雨水浸透ます) programme -- covers full (100%) installation/construction cost, free to the resident except "special/non-standard construction work" (特殊な工事は除く), limited to existing detached houses and privately-owned multi-unit residences, up to 6 units per lot; excludes installations by the national/local government or public corporations, by corporations generally, installations required under Chofu's Development Guidance Ordinance Art.16(2), new-build or temporary-structure installations, and installations by real-estate/construction businesses for resale purposes. Ongoing cleaning/maintenance after installation is the owner's responsibility under both programmes and is not covered.
Covers a portion (1/2) of the purchase price of a rainwater storage tank, up to ¥20,000; no mention of installation labor, delivery, or maintenance costs being covered separately

Covers costs of installing rainwater infiltration boxes (雨水浸透マス) and rainwater storage tanks (雨水貯留槽) at residential buildings (owner-occupied houses or apartment/multi-unit housing) on sites under 1,000㎡: material and construction costs (材料費、工事費等) when contracted to a business, or material costs only (材料費のみ) when self-installed by the applicant. Subsidy is a flat amount per unit, capped by number of units allowed (infiltration boxes tiered by building roof area: 1 unit if <50㎡, 2 if 50-100㎡, 3 if 100-150㎡, 4 if ≥150㎡; storage tanks capped at 1 per building). Excludes: materials purchased before application/approval; labor costs when self-installed; and conversion of decommissioned septic tanks to storage use is handled separately case-by-case via consultation rather than automatically covered.

Covers installation cost of newly-installed rainwater infiltration basins (雨水浸透ます A型/B型) and rainwater storage tanks (雨水貯留タンク, ≥200L combined capacity) on the site of a privately owned building with rain gutters, within the urban planning area, up to fixed per-unit subsidy caps (A型: ¥100,000/unit; B型: ¥50,000/unit; storage tank: ¥30,000/unit), capped at 1 unit for buildings <50㎡ and 2 units for buildings ≥50㎡; excludes installation in sabo-designated areas, landslide-prevention areas, steep-slope collapse hazard areas, sites where installation risks slope/wall instability, and sites planned for other land-use/development projects; excludes applicants who have received or are scheduled to receive other national/local government subsidies for the same facility; and excludes ongoing maintenance/cleaning costs, which remain the owner's responsibility.

Covers: purchase price (incl. tax) of the rainwater storage tank itself (≥100L, sealed, off-the-shelf, connected to building's rain gutter, one unit or 2+ connected units per building) plus accessories (anti-tip chain, stand, connection parts). Excludes: installation/setup labor cost and shipping/delivery fee (送料・設置費は助成対象外); points/coupon-discounted portions of purchase; tanks on buildings that previously received this or a similar subsidy; consumption-tax deductible portion for corporate applicants must be netted out or returned.

Covers 3/4 (75%) of the rainwater storage tank purchase price, including accessories and consumption tax, rounded down below ¥1,000, capped at ¥40,000; excludes delivery and installation costs; limited to one tank per building (one building if applicant owns multiple).

Covered costs: rain tank unit (tank body + accessory parts, 1 set, tank capacity ≥100L) and stop-board installation/construction work, within the designated inundation-basic-plan zones (1,510 ha), up to specified subsidy rate/caps (rain tank: 1/2 of eligible cost or capacity-tiered cap, whichever lower; stop-board: 2/3 of eligible cost or ¥500,000 cap, whichever lower). Excluded: the portion of purchase price paid using points/coupons; applicants delinquent on city tax or sewerage-use fees/beneficiary charges; occupiers without consent of the land/building owner; those installing for display or sales purposes; national/local public bodies and equivalent public entities; and any application submitted after installation (application must precede installation).

Two-scheme free-text coding: (1) Veranda/balcony greening (apartments): COVERED -- purchase of trees (≥1 tree ≥1.5m tall), pots (≥10-go) or planters (≥10L), soil, fertilizer, and irrigation-related equipment; if outsourced to a professional contractor, also base/irrigation construction costs, planting labor costs, and incidental expenses for greening-facility development. EXCLUDED -- annual-plant/vegetable-garden greening, replacement of existing trees, decorative items unrelated to plant growth, and indoor-only houseplants (tree must be permanently installed and visible from a public road); purchases/orders made before the grant decision (交付決定) are also excluded . (2) Downtown office/commercial/lodging building greening: COVERED -- mandatory outdoor greening (vacant-land greening, wall/façade greening, other building/balcony greening) and, only when combined with the mandatory outdoor greening, effect-promoting greening (indoor greening/flower-bed installation). Maintenance and monitoring costs are not mentioned as covered under either scheme (Not stated).

Covers: rainwater storage tank/facility unit purchase cost, installation/construction cost, and materials purchase cost for self-installation (E-1 programme); conversion construction cost of disused septic tank into rainwater storage facility upon sewer connection (E-2 programme). Excludes: costs above the 1/2 share or above the respective caps (¥30,000 / ¥80,000), and requires no outstanding municipal tax arrears (E-2).

Covers: cost of installing a new merged-treatment (johkasou) septic tank at owner-occupied single-family homes (new build, or conversion from single-treatment tank/pit toilet), full removal of the old single-treatment tank or pit toilet, in-house piping works needed for conversion, and reuse of the old tank as a temporary rainwater storage vessel. Excludes: properties within public sewerage-authorized areas or agricultural-settlement drainage project areas; tanks larger than 10-person capacity; no coverage of ongoing maintenance/operation of the septic system after installation.

Two-measure programme with distinct coverage/exclusion rules: Rain barrel/cistern: Covers 2/3 of the tank body purchase price (incl. tax), capped at ¥50,000 (fractions under ¥1,000 dropped); installation/piping labor not explicitly covered. Excludes housing held by real-estate/developer for resale, sites without landowner consent, and applicants with unpaid municipal taxes. Infiltration facility: Covers 90% of standard construction cost per official unit-price table, capped at ¥400,000 (諸経費/incidental expenses excluded). Excludes sites ≥1,000m² subject to the Fussa residential land development guidance ordinance, and temporary housing.

Covers half the purchase price (rounded down to nearest ¥100, capped at ¥14,000) of a qualifying commercially-sold rainwater storage tank (≥100L, roof-fed via gutter, durable ground-fixed type) plus the purchase cost of necessary intake and installation equipment; excludes delivery and installation labour costs. Eligibility (implied by applicant conditions) limited to one tank per resident household with no unpaid municipal tax or water bills.

Rain barrel/tank (雨水貯留槽): Covered = 1/2 of the unit purchase price, including consumption tax and functionally necessary parts (faucet, gutter/downspout connector, stand, anti-tip device), up to a cap of ¥25,000 (rounded down to nearest ¥100). Excluded = points/coupons used, optional accessories, shipping, and installation labor cost. Infiltration facility (雨水浸透ます・浸透トレンチ): Covered = 9/10 of the lesser of (a) cost calculated by the standard unit-price schedule or (b) the actual contractor invoice amount (incl. tax), up to a cap of ¥400,000; rate rises to 10/10 (full cost) within designated infiltration-enhancement districts (雨水浸透強化地区). Excluded = facilities installed as part of new-build/extension construction, facilities installed under projects mandated by the City Planning Act Art. 43 or the City's residential-land/collective-housing development guidance ordinances; installation is also not permitted in steep-slope collapse hazard zones or landslide-prevention zones.

Covers: 50% of installation cost for rainwater infiltration basins (up to 4/lot, ¥12,500/unit cap) and 50% of paving cost for permeable pavement (up to 50m²/lot, ¥1,000/m² cap), for owner-occupied houses, offices, or shops. Excludes: properties outside the designated groundwater recharge zone (本町・南・東・北・西地区 with some exclusions), and infiltration/detention facilities installed under Machizukuri Ordinance Art.32-2 or Art.35-5 (development-mandated facilities). Applies to new and existing (non-new) buildings alike. Pre-installation approval required; post-installation applications are ineligible.

Covers: purchase cost of commercially available rainwater storage tank (incl. necessary parts) and its installation work cost, for tanks collecting roof runoff on a building owned/used within the city. Excludes: buildings held for resale, national/local government buildings, and any tank not from municipal-specification purchase; each eligible building may receive the subsidy only once (except disaster damage).
Covers 50% of eligible rainwater-tank purchase and installation costs for a new tank of at least 100 litres at a self-occupied city residence, capped at ¥20,000 per household

Covers a portion of installation/construction costs for six eligible on-site rainwater storage/infiltration facility types: (1) converted septic tank storage (対象経費の2/3, ¥75,000/unit), (2) rain storage tanks (工事費の1/2, ¥18,000/unit for 80-200L, ¥25,000/unit for ≥200L, limited to max 2 units per property), (3) infiltration inlets/chambers (口径≥200mm, 1/2 of cost, ¥9,000/location), (4) infiltration pipes (口径≥50mm, 1/2 of cost, ¥3,000/metre), (5) infiltration side-ditches (内幅≥240mm, 1/2 of cost, ¥8,000/metre), (6) permeable paving (area≥10m², 1/2 of cost, ¥1,000/m²) -- each subject to its own per-unit/per-area/per-metre subsidy cap, with a combined overall cap of ¥150,000 per application when multiple facilities are installed together; amounts under ¥1,000 are rounded down; excludes costs below the stated minimum size/diameter thresholds, and excludes design/planning, permitting, and maintenance/monitoring costs (not listed as covered items)

Covers 75% of standard acquisition and designated-contractor installation costs for eligible tanks, infiltration basins and trench pipes, capped at ¥120,000 per building; advance approval, eligible-zone and site-size rules apply

Covers: purchase price of the rainwater tank unit and accessories (anti-tip device, mount, connection parts) for new tanks, or installation work cost for septic-tank conversions. Excludes: consumption tax, shipping/delivery fees, online-store loyalty points used toward purchase, and (for new tank purchases) installation labor cost.

Covers: construction/installation costs of greening facilities (green roof, green wall, ground planting, flower beds/turf) and solar power devices, specifically for the portion of the site's greening exceeding the ordinance-mandated minimum greening ratio, up to 1/2 of that excess cost or ¥500,000 (whichever lower). Excludes: land purchase, design/planning fees, permitting fees, ongoing maintenance, and monitoring costs (not mentioned as covered); base/mandated-ratio greening (i.e., the portion required by ordinance) is not subsidised -- only the amount exceeding the required ratio is eligible.

Covers: purchase cost of a city-certified rainwater storage tank, plus installation work cost (if installed by a contractor); if self-installed, only the purchase cost is covered. Excludes: facilities owned by the national government/local public bodies or entities they fund/invest in; excludes non-certified products.

Materials and conversion work to reuse an existing single-treatment septic tank as rainwater storage; lower of actual eligible cost or JPY 90,000; application before work and completion by 23 March 2027

Two-thirds of construction cost for converted septic-tank storage, prefabricated rainwater tanks and Type I/II infiltration pits; per-facility caps apply; recipient bears post-completion maintenance and damage
Dedicated rainwater tank of at least 80 L plus diverter, connectors and stand; two-thirds up to JPY 30,000; installation labour excluded; apply before purchase

Construction or installation of converted/new rainwater storage, infiltration pits, permeable paving and flood boards, subject to facility-specific formulas, caps, standards, advance application and exclusions

Purchase and contractor installation of qualifying rainwater tanks and infiltration pits; self-installers may claim purchase only; percentage, unit and site caps apply; maintenance agreement and 7-year retention required

Purchase and installation of qualifying rainwater tanks and construction of infiltration pits, including eligible self-installation materials; two-thirds formula with unit and parcel caps; apply before purchase/install and claim after completion inspection

Materials and installation for qualifying rainwater tanks, infiltration pits and septic-tank conversions; 50% with facility caps; advance application and completion by 20 March of the application fiscal year
Current-round combined-treatment septic installation, associated piping, eligible old-tank removal or rainwater-storage reuse, with fixed category/size amounts and fiscal-year completion conditions
New rainwater tank, accessories and installation work; 50% up to JPY 30,000; delivery excluded

Construction/purchase shares for infiltration pits, rainwater tanks, converted septic storage and flood boards, with facility-specific caps, advance application, current-round deadlines and participant maintenance guidance
Qualifying rainwater-tank purchase price only; 50% up to JPY 30,000 per tank
Half of city-approved installation cost for qualifying storage or infiltration facilities, capped at JPY 38,000/JPY 22,000 per facility and two facilities per application; 10-year use/upkeep duty
One qualifying rainwater tank or eligible accessories; two-thirds of purchase cost up to JPY 40,000; installation/delivery excluded; reimbursement after report; 5-year maintenance/retention duty
Covers purchase and installation costs of the rainwater storage tank and its accessories; limited to 1 unit per household; requires approval prior to installation
Installation work converting an existing septic tank made redundant by public-sewer connection into rainwater storage; JPY 40,000 cap; application submitted with the sewer-connection application

Covers 3/4 of the purchase price (up to ¥30,000) of eligible items: rainwater tank body, downspout diverter/branch fitting purchase cost, tank stand purchase cost (foundation work excluded), and integrated submersible pump purchase cost (only if integral to the tank). Excludes: shipping/delivery costs, gutter/downspout costs, installation/construction work costs, hoses and other non-listed items. Use restriction: prohibited for toilet-flushing use (permitted uses include garden watering, street-sprinkling, emergency water use).
Publicly funded site assessment, materials and installation of a rainwater infiltration well; post-installation cleaning/inspection excluded and assigned to owner

Covers up to one-half of installation cost of eligible rainwater-utilisation equipment. Storage tank: commercial product ≥150 L, half of cost up to ¥30,000 per unit, 1 unit per building; self-made tank, flat ¥5,000 per building. Infiltration pit: ≥30 cm internal diameter, concrete or PVC with lid, half of cost up to ¥50,000 for max 4 pits per building, or up to ¥70,000 per building where 10 or more buildings install as a group. Storage tanks eligible city-wide; infiltration pits only within the urbanisation-promotion area or use-zoned area (part of Kuchiawano). Excluded: infiltration pits installed under development-permit guidance. Applications accepted only after installation is complete and within the same fiscal year as completion.

Covered: installation costs only -- materials, construction/installation work, and incidental expenses (諸経費) for eligible rainwater storage/infiltration facilities (septic-tank-conversion storage tanks, rain tanks/雨水タンク [max 2 per contiguous lot], infiltration inlets/雨水浸透ます, infiltration pipes/雨水浸透管, infiltration side ditches/雨水浸透側溝, permeable paving/透水性舗装). Subsidy amount = lesser of the per-facility/per-scale cap listed in the schedule or 2/3 of eligible costs, with an overall cap of ¥200,000 per contiguous site (一団の土地) for the tank category. Excluded: maintenance/operating costs (not listed as eligible), and any costs exceeding the per-facility caps, the 2/3 ratio, or the ¥200,000 overall cap.

Covers: construction/labor and material costs (工事費及び材料費) for converting a septic tank (浄化槽) into a rainwater storage facility, only when carried out concurrently with public sewer drainage connection work; subsidy = 2/3 of eligible cost (rounded down below ¥1,000), capped at ¥100,000. Excludes: applicants that are government offices, corporations, or other organizations (limited to individual resident homeowners); excludes ongoing maintenance/upkeep costs (maintenance is instead an eligibility condition, not a covered cost); excludes cases not done concurrently with drainage connection work.

Covers: material costs (材料費) and installation/construction work costs (設置工事等の費用, including labor when done by a contractor) for rainwater storage tanks, infiltration facilities (soakaway pits), and septic-tank-to-storage conversion facilities, at 1/2 of eligible cost up to tiered caps by facility type/capacity -- excluding consumption/local consumption tax. If the applicant self-installs, only material costs are eligible (labor-equivalent expenses excluded). Not covered: design/planning and permitting fees, ongoing maintenance/monitoring costs (not mentioned as covered); items purchased/installed before the grant approval notice is received; facilities not meeting the technical standards in the funding guideline; a second application for the same subsidy within the same fiscal year; and facilities not inspected within the fiscal year.

Covers: installation construction cost of infiltration soakaways and small rainwater storage tanks (1/2 of cost up to tiered caps). Excludes: ongoing cleaning/maintenance costs (explicitly requested of owner but not funded), and facilities on temporary or for-profit buildings.

Covers: purchase price (tax included, per quote/estimate) of a sealed, ready-made rainwater tank (≥100L capacity) plus listed accessories (intake fitting/joint, intake pipe, faucet/tap, fixing hardware/bracket, dedicated stand), reimbursed at 2/3 of cost or ¥20,000 per unit (per building), whichever is lower, one grant per building. Excludes: shipping/delivery fees, installation/labour costs, and any portion paid via points/coupons/gift certificates. Eligibility-linked exclusions: corporations and individual business operators; dwellings not connected/not expected to connect to the public sewer; applicants with tax or utility (municipal tax/water-sewer fee) arrears or organized-crime (bōryokudan) ties.

Covers 75% (工事費の4分の3) of construction/installation costs for eligible facilities-converted septic-tank storage tanks, new rainwater storage tanks (≥100L), infiltration pits, infiltration trenches, and permeable pavement-subject to facility-specific per-unit caps (e.g., ¥150,000-300,000 for converted tanks, ¥36,000-240,000 for tanks by volume, ¥150,000/¥175,000/¥250,000 caps for infiltration pits/trenches/permeable pavement); excludes design/planning, permitting, maintenance and monitoring costs; conditional on prior application (事前申請) and full payment of municipal taxes (市税完納)

Covers: 2/3 of installation/construction cost of rainwater storage tanks (new or via septic-tank conversion) and infiltration basins, up to type-specific caps (¥20,000-¥100,000), max 1 unit of each type per building. Excludes: temporary structures, buildings for commercial/resale purposes, installations legally mandated by law/ordinance, and installations by national/local government or equivalent bodies.

Covers (90% subsidy, tax-included): for new rainwater storage tanks (≥100L, product cost + necessary installation materials + installation labor costs), 9/10 of total construction cost up to tiered caps by capacity (full subsidy if total cost ≤¥10,000 and capacity ≥100L); for infiltration pits, per-unit amounts (¥10,000/¥20,000 standard, or ¥20,000/¥30,000 in designated priority areas); for infiltration trenches, ¥3,500/metre; for permeable pavement, ¥500/m². Excludes: agency/application-proxy fees and self-installation labor costs; facilities installed by national/local government, independent administrative agencies, national university corporations, Japan Post group, expressway companies, or policy finance corporations; facilities installed to meet Kōnan City's residential development guidance requirements (宅地開発等指導要綱); facilities installed to satisfy obligations under the Act on Special Measures for Flood Damage Mitigation in Specified Urban Rivers (Art. 9/16) or Kōnan's development-permit ordinance (Art. 3-5); remodeling/conversion of facilities that already received this or another Kōnan subsidy; relocation-compensation (function-restoration) installations; septic-tank conversions to rainwater tanks within public sewer service areas (a separate subsidy applies there); repairs or replacement of existing units; and work already begun before application approval.

Covers: cleaning/conversion of septic tank or installation of underground storage tank, associated rainwater piping, pump/spigot installation (Measure 1); infiltration pit body and piping (Measure 2); above-ground rain tank purchase plus fittings/mounts/anti-tip hardware (Measure 3). Excludes: shipping fees and installation labor cost for the above-ground tank category; tanks under 100L capacity are ineligible entirely.

Covers: partial subsidy ("助成") of costs for rooftop greening (屋上緑化) and wall/façade greening (壁面緑化) on buildings within Kumamoto Prefecture's urbanization-promotion areas, use-zoned areas, or landscape-plan-designated priority/special-facility districts, limited to projects selected as exemplary "model" greening cases (selection via review within budget). Excludes: all other NbS/greening types not mentioned (e.g., rain gardens, permeable paving, street trees, rain barrels); no specific cost items (design, permitting, maintenance, monitoring) are itemized as covered or excluded -- detailed eligibility/coverage specifics are deferred to the operating body (Kumamoto Green & Landscape Collaboration Organization)'s own website, not given on this page.

Covers: purchase cost of the rain barrel/infiltration box + its installation cost, up to the stated caps. Excludes: ongoing maintenance/upkeep costs (applicant must be able to maintain long-term), design/planning fees, permitting fees, and monitoring -- none of these are mentioned as covered.

Covers: purchase cost of the certified advanced-treatment septic tank (合併処理浄化槽) and its installation/construction, plus removal of the old single-treatment tank or its conversion into a rainwater storage tank; if in-house piping subsidy is claimed, also covers inflow pipe to the tank, manhole/catch-basin installation, and discharge pipe to the adjacent roadside ditch. Excludes: ongoing maintenance, legal inspection fees, blower replacement, and any costs beyond the flat subsidy ceiling (applicant bears the remainder); excludes rental properties/vacation homes and non-owner-occupied uses.

Covers 3/4 of the purchase cost of the rainwater storage tank unit (本体) and integrated attachments only, up to ¥45,000/building/year; excludes shipping (送料) and installation/construction costs (設置工事費用); eligible tanks must be commercial products (≥100L, sealed type) purchased from city-based vendors; restricted to buildings within the designated 西地区 (Nishi district) target area along the 高野川 (Kono River) basin flood-countermeasure project zone.

Covers: purchase of rainwater storage tank body (≥100L capacity), piping/materials for rainwater collection and drainage, pump equipment for reuse (irrigation/washing), infiltration drywell (≥150mm) materials, and associated construction/incidental costs. Excludes: sludge removal and tank cleaning costs. Eligibility requires full payment of municipal taxes, sewerage beneficiary charges, sewerage usage fees, and agricultural community drainage charges. One application per household per fiscal year per measure type; infiltration facilities limited to 4 sites per lot.

Sludge removal/cleaning; removal of unnecessary internal parts and partition-hole work; rainwater collection/drainage piping; pump installation; other work necessary for conversion to rainwater storage

Covers: structural/load-bearing safety survey and design fees, waterproofing equipment (roof only), planting/vegetation installation costs, support/anchoring material installation (wall only), and irrigation system installation, up to half of eligible cost with area minimums (roof ≥3m², wall ≥10m²); fixed planters ≥100L also eligible. Excludes: ongoing maintenance/watering costs beyond installation, permitting fees, and monitoring costs (only a 5-year annual photo-report condition applies to moss/sedum, not a paid monitoring service).
Covers conversion of an existing septic tank (johkaso) into a rainwater storage facility; specific cost items included/excluded (labor, materials, permitting) not stated in accessible sources

Covers: construction/installation cost of rainwater infiltration boxes (雨水浸透マス Type A/B) and rainwater storage facilities (septic-tank-conversion type and simple tank type) for general residential housing (一般住宅) citywide, reimbursed as the lesser of actual construction cost (or half of it, for storage facilities) or a fixed per-unit yen cap, limited to a maximum number of units per house (2 for infiltration boxes, 1 for each storage type). Excludes: costs above the stated caps, and non-construction costs such as design, permitting, monitoring, and maintenance/repair, which are not listed among reimbursable items; application must precede construction/purchase.

Covers installation/construction costs (設置に要する費用, tax-exclusive basis) of three eligible facility types: rainwater storage tanks (≥100L capacity), rainwater infiltration facilities (≥300mm diameter infiltration boxes with gravel fill, urbanization-promotion zones only), and septic-tank-converted storage systems with pump -- for properties in Mito City; excludes consumption tax (breakdown/quote must show tax-excluded price) and, by omission from the eligible-cost/document list, land purchase and maintenance/monitoring/design-permitting costs

Covers: 1/2 of the installation cost (tank unit purchase price + accessories + installation work, tax included), capped at ¥50,000; tank must be ≥100L capacity, lidded with drain function, directly connected to a rain gutter, unused, and installable within the fiscal year; limited to one tank per residence/building (house, storehouse, garage, etc.) within the city per fiscal year. Excludes: costs beyond the 1/2/¥50,000 cap, maintenance/monitoring costs, design/permitting costs not part of installation, and used/second-hand tanks; units removed within 7 years require a discontinuation notice (廃止届).

Covers: 1/2 of combined equipment/material purchase cost and installation work cost for rainwater storage tanks (rain barrel/cistern type, gutter-connected, ≥150L capacity, with drainage function) and rainwater infiltration pits (gutter/drainpipe-connected, ≥35cm diameter or 30cm square, ≥50cm depth), capped at ¥25,000/unit (tanks) and ¥10,000/unit (pits), max 2 units of each per building. Excludes: costs beyond the per-unit caps, more than 2 units of each type per building, and does not mention coverage of design/planning, permitting, ongoing maintenance, repair, or monitoring costs.
Covers purchase of tanks ≥80 L and attached equipment, shipping and taxes; maximum two tanks/building. Excludes installation/construction costs.

Covers: unit/material price and installation cost of qualifying rain tanks (3/4 of each, capped) and material cost (plus installation cost for pre-Sept-2012 houses) of standard-spec rainwater infiltration inlets/trenches. Excludes: consumption tax portion of price, and any amount from discount coupons (post-discount price only is eligible; corporate loyalty points ARE eligible). Not covered: green roofs, façades, rain gardens, permeable paving, trees, ongoing maintenance.

Covers: purchase/material cost of rainwater storage tanks (≥100L capacity, max 2/dwelling) and conversion cost of disused septic tanks into rainwater storage. Excludes: hose attachments, foundation/base work, and general installation labor costs (蛇口先のホース、施設の基礎、設置費用は対象になりません). Renters/occupants eligible with building owner's written consent.

Covers: 50% of the purchase/installation cost of (a) commercially sold rainwater storage tanks ≥100L capacity, up to ¥20,000, and (b) anti-flood boards installed at building/site entrances, up to ¥750,000; product must be purchased/installed only after the approval notice is received. Excludes: product brokerage/arrangement by the city, ongoing inspection/cleaning/maintenance costs, and any purchase/installation completed before the approval notice is issued.

Covers: 1/2 of purchase and installation cost of a small-scale rainwater storage tank (≥100L, commercial, connected to downspout), capped at ¥30,000; or 1/2 of purchase and installation cost of a septic-tank-conversion rainwater storage facility, capped at ¥100,000. Excludes: tank interior cleaning fee (槽内清掃費) for septic-conversion type; applications after facility purchase are ineligible; excludes tanks converted under the separate joint-treatment septic tank subsidy programme.

Covers: cost of drainage/sewer connection construction work (existing pit-latrine or septic-tank households switching to public sewer) up to a capped grant amount; also covers partial cost of converting a now-redundant septic tank into a rainwater storage facility within 3 years of service start. Excludes: applications tied to new-build construction on vacant land (no pre-existing septic tank/pit latrine), application/administrative fees, and any costs not part of the construction quote (e.g., 申請手数料など工事費用に含まれない費用は補助の対象外).

Covers: 1/2 of the purchase cost of a new, ready-made (既製品) rainwater storage tank of ≥50L capacity, one unit per household, capped at ¥30,000; eligible applicants must reside in Neyagawa City in a detached house (一戸建て住宅等) and must certify no arrears in prior-year resident tax. Excludes: used/self-built tanks, installation/labor costs beyond the tank purchase price itself, and (not mentioned as covered) design, permitting, maintenance, or monitoring costs.

Covers: a portion of installation/construction costs for privately-owned rainwater infiltration inlets (雨水浸透ます) -- construction cost per unit installed, capped at ¥20,000/unit -- and one rainwater storage tank per household (¥1,000-¥20,000 depending on tank type: commercial vs. self-made, and whether installed alone or with an infiltration inlet), with storage tanks required to be ≥100L. Excludes: repair, replacement, removal or relocation costs of already-installed devices (owner's responsibility); items already purchased/installed before receiving pre-approval notice; storage tanks under 100 liters; sites unsuitable for infiltration (steep-slope/no-installation zones, high-groundwater areas); properties in sewerage-service areas whose drainage is not yet connected to the sewer; applicants delinquent on city taxes, sewerage-project beneficiary charges, or sewerage usage fees; and properties outside the designated Sewerage Law project-plan area.

Covers: design/planning fees, on-site survey fees, installation of infiltration sump (浸透ます) and infiltration trench (浸透トレンチ), gutter/downspout connection costs, removal and restoration of concrete pavement where needed, and purchase/installation of rain tanks. Excludes: any structures for houses already covered by prior grant, houses within developments already required to have code-compliant infiltration facilities (per City's people-friendly development ordinance), houses on plots ≥500m², and ongoing maintenance/cleaning costs after installation.

Supported: materials, construction and incidental expenses for septic-tank conversion, tanks and associated pipework, infiltration inlets/pipes/side-ditches, permeable pavement and equivalent facilities. Verbatim examples: 「材料費、工事費、諸経費」 and 「設置に要した経費に3分の2を乗じて得た額」. Caps are ¥70,000 per tank, ¥100,000 for two or more tanks per site, and generally ¥100,000 per site for infiltration facilities.

Covers: 1/2 of the installation/purchase cost of a newly-installed eligible rainwater storage tank (≥100L capacity with rainwater-use function, including septic-tank conversions), subject to tiered per-tank caps by size (¥20,000/30,000/50,000) and an overall ¥50,000 max per applicant/year. Excludes: tanks already installed before application, and ongoing maintenance costs (owner's responsibility).

Covers: material/installation cost of rainwater infiltration facilities Type A (up to full cost or ¥100,000, whichever is less), Type B (up to full cost or ¥50,000, whichever is less), and rainwater storage tanks with total capacity ≥200L (up to full cost or ¥30,000, whichever is less), with number of A/B units capped by building floor area (1-4 units). Excludes: costs for installations required as a condition of development permits (開発行為等の条件による設置), sites judged unsuitable for infiltration devices (steep-slope collapse zones, sediment disaster warning/special warning areas, erosion-control designated areas, or areas where soil/surrounding structures make installation unsuitable), and any amount exceeding the stated per-unit caps.

Covers: plant/material purchase, planting labor by professional landscapers, removal of existing obstructing structures (e.g., block walls) directly tied to the greened area. Excludes: DIY labor (self-performed construction), reuse of existing plants/materials, projects already legally mandated to green (e.g., development ordinance requirements), projects receiving other municipal greening subsidies, and projects on property developed for sale/rent.
Rainwater tank and specified fittings; installation labour and shipping excluded

Covers: 1/2 of construction cost (or material cost for tanks) for installing rainwater storage/infiltration facilities, up to item-specific caps and an overall ¥90,000/application cap. Excludes: tank foundation/platform work and tank unit installation labor cost, replacement of existing facilities, work already subsidised elsewhere, restorations due to relocation compensation, installations legally mandated by development permits, and repeat installations on a site that already received the subsidy.
Rainwater storage and infiltration facility installation; new-build, extension and building-renovation works excluded

Covers: 2/3 of the rainwater tank purchase/installation cost (including consumption tax, attached parts, and transport/delivery costs), capped at ¥60,000 (amounts under ¥1,000 rounded down); tank must be ≥100L capacity, one unit per applicant. Excludes: separate stands/pedestals (別付け台座等). Not applicable: installations in urbanization-control zones (市街化調整区域) -- the subsidy cannot be used there at all; program is limited to urbanization-promotion zones (市街化区域). Additional eligibility conditions: no outstanding municipal tax arrears, tank installed within 1 year prior to application, and proper ongoing maintenance/management of the tank.

Subsidy covers part of the installation cost of rainwater storage tanks/rainwater storage-infiltration facilities (雨水貯留浸透施設) at private residences; detailed scope of what is included/excluded (design, permitting, maintenance, caps) is not specified on this page and requires conditions per the linked pamphlet/交付要綱 (grant guidelines) -- Not stated beyond installation-cost subsidy.
